title: Portillo and Los Libertadores
slogan: The old road to Argentina: thirty numbered hairpins stacked up the Caracoles to three thousand metres.

waypoints.name: Caracoles
waypoints.advice: The high point of this section, 3200 m up. The road climbs 320 m over the 32 km before it, steadily. At this height the road is a summer one: snow gates can stay shut into June and shut again in October.

scenicChapters.title: Paso de los Libertadores
scenicChapters.narrative: First and second gear more often than not. Corners stack above one another where the ground allows nothing straighter.

story: 96 km from Los Andes to the finish, about 1 h 51 of riding. On the way it passes Río Blanco and Portillo. The climb of the day is Caracoles. It tops out at 3,200 m. Cristo Redentor Pass is subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. It crosses from Chile into Argentina - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.

title: Valparaíso Coast Road
slogan: North from Valparaíso along the Pacific: dunes, pelicans and long open curves with nothing between the road and the water.

story: A one-way ride of 128 km, Valparaíso to the finish - roughly 2 h 28 in the saddle. It goes by way of Concon and Maitencillo. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
